chunks: It is We who created you, so why do you not affirm the truth?
ai.seo_question: Why does God ask humans why they do not believe in resurrection?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Infitar, this verse underscores the logical necessity of resurrection by linking the initial act of creation (khalaqna) to the power of recreation, a core tenet in Shia theological discourse on divine omnipotence. It serves as a rhetorical challenge to human arrogance, reminding believers that the Creator who brought them from non-existence is fully capable of restoring them for judgment.
